name: Behavioral Anomaly Detection
description: Detects anomalous agent behavior by comparing real-time activity against per-agent behavioral baselines.
threat_addressed: Compromised agents operating within authorized scope but exhibiting anomalous behavior — unusual patterns, volume spikes, rapid sequences — evade scope-based controls.
enforcement_mechanism: Per-agent behavioral baselines built from operational history. Real-time comparison of current activity against baseline. Anomalies trigger alerts. MVP tracks tool call frequency, scope patterns, and timing.

security_outcome.fail: Behavioral anomaly detected — deviation from established baseline.

display_detail: Tracks agent behavior patterns and flags deviations from established baselines. Monitors tool call frequency, diversity, and timing.
remediation_hint_template: Behavioral anomaly detected — agent activity deviates from established baseline. Review recent tool call patterns and verify this activity is expected.
